# Architecture Brief — v2.7.0 Phase 0 Shared Foundations

resource: scripts/harness/stage-state.mjs, harness.config.json, .env.example, package.json

**Date:** 2026-08-03  
**Status:** APPROVED

## Goal

Extract `stage-state.mjs` — the single source of truth for live stage state and approval records.
Downstream consumers (v3.0 control panel, v2.9 Teams notifier, v2.8 doc workflow) all read/write
through this module. No existing scripts are modified.

## Exports

```
readStageState(options?)   → StateRecord | null
writeStageState(state, options?)
readApprovals(options?)    → ApprovalRecord[]
writeApproval(approval, options?)
APPROVAL_STATUSES          → Set<string>
VALID_MODES                → Set<string>
defaultStateDir            → string (absolute path)
```

## State files

| File | Path | Format | Write strategy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Live state | `.github/harness/runs/stage-state.json` | JSON | Atomic: temp + renameSync |
| Approvals log | `.github/harness/runs/approvals.jsonl` | NDJSON | appendFileSync |

## Config additions (backward-compatible)

```jsonc
{
  "mode": "dev",          // "dev" | "doc-workflow"; default "dev"
  "docWorkflow": { ... }  // placeholder for v2.8.0; ignored when mode=dev
}
```

## Do-NOTs

- Do NOT modify run-loop.mjs, record-run.mjs, or harness-report.mjs.
- Do NOT add npm dependencies.
- Do NOT make functions async (keep sync for consistency with rest of harness).
